name: Andreas Schieder - Après le § 23 - Am 21
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Albania
part_text: 23a. Acknowledges the progress Albania has made in recognizing the Aromanians as a national (ethnic) minority, a community that continues to face persistent challenges related to the preservation of its language, culture, and heritage; calls for the Government of Albania to take further measures to ensure the full preservation of the Aromanian community’s identity;
